name: Dual-Zone Perimeter Breach — AND_ACTIVE
description: Fires only when a door I/O sensor is actively open AND motion is simultaneously active — both triggers must be in their active state at the same time. Unlike AND+trigger_window (which fires if both events occur within N seconds of each other, even sequentially), AND_ACTIVE requires genuine simultaneous presence. A door that opens and closes cleanly with no overlap with active motion is ignored. Demonstrates trigger_logic AND_ACTIVE and mqtt_publish on_failure fallback.
